name: Malefic-Touched Perils
summary: When Perils is triggered by a Malefic power, the GM may use this table or add +2 to the normal Perils severity roll. descriptionMarkdown:
When Perils is triggered by a Malefic power, the GM may use this table or add +2 to the normal
Perils severity roll. These results should feel predatory, corrupting, and narratively dangerous.
Severity Malefic Peril Result
2-6 Malignant Static You take 1d6 psychic damage and have disadvantage on your next saving throw against fear, 
charm, or corruption.
7-10 Blooded Eyes You take 2d6 psychic damage and a nearby Warp entity, cult icon, or daemon-touched creature 
becomes aware of your presence.
11-14 Predatory Echo Every creature within 10 ft, including you, takes 2d6 psychic damage. The GM may describe a 
hostile voice, omen, or watching presence.
15-18 Daemon Scream Creatures of your choice within 30 ft must make a Wisdom save or become frightened until the 
end of their next turn. After Perils is reduced, your Warp Pressure increases by 1.
19-22 Possession Pressure You are incapacitated until the end of your next turn. Make a Charisma save against your Psychic 
Save DC; on a failure, gain 1 Corruption.
23-26 Unbidden Manifestation The GM chooses a random Malefic power you know. If you know no valid Malefic power, Terror 
Echo manifests instead. The target is random.
27-30 Reality Wound A 10-ft radius area within 30 ft becomes corrupted terrain for 1 minute. Creatures entering or 
starting there take 2d6 psychic damage. Daemons and corrupted creatures have advantage on 
their next attack made from inside it.
31+ Catastrophic Breach You drop to 0 hit points. Every creature within 30 ft takes 4d6 psychic damage. A hostile Warp 
entity, possession threat, or daemon sign enters the scene, and you gain 2 Corruption instead of 
1.
